overview.description: The Baillie Gifford International Alpha ETF (BGIA) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively invests in all-cap stocks of companies located outside of the US. Stocks are selected based on fundamental analysis and weighted based on conviction. BGIA was launched on Jun 2, 2026 and is issued by Baillie Gifford Funds.
